blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon — The poorest households in Bukidnon province struggled with a 9.5-percent inflation in September, up from 8.0 percent in August, driven mainly by rising food prices—particularly rice and corn. Data released by the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) on October 12 showed that the average inflation rate for the province’s bottom 30% income households reached 7.8 percent for the first nine months of the year. The current figure marks a steep reversal from the -0.8 percent deflation recorded in September 2025.
